title: evolvulus serpylloides
intro: Evolvulus serpylloides, commonly known as Dwarf Blue Daisy, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Evolvulus serpylloides include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe wounds and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
